rationale: Code changes strictly adhere to the requirements. Exposes run command at top-level and workflows run subcommand under sdk workflows. Handled input parameter parsing (for string and JSON objects), file and session parameters, and name-to-ID resolution of workflows. Unit and integration tests successfully written and passing cleanly.

business_review.criterion: Ticket AC1 - CLI provides a documented command to run any accessible workflow (shared or custom) by ID or name
business_review.notes: Both 'codemie run' and 'codemie sdk workflows run' are implemented and documented with clean examples.

business_review.criterion: Ticket AC2 - CLI command executes the workflow and returns console output or artifacts
business_review.notes: Commands invoke SDK workflow.run and output response formatted as JSON.

business_review.criterion: Ticket AC3 - Command accepts workflow input variables/parameters
business_review.notes: Handled --input option, successfully parsing it as JSON or falling back to string.

business_review.criterion: Ticket AC4 - Feature is documented for both sharing workflows and running them via CLI
business_review.notes: Help text and examples are embedded directly into the CLI commands.

business_review.criterion: Ticket AC5 - No regression for existing CLI usage patterns
business_review.notes: All existing CLI tests, build, typecheck, and linter pass completely cleanly.

standards_review.notes: The implementation plan specifies strict compliance with Conventional Commits.
eslint --max-warnings=0 and tsc --noEmit are verified and clean.
